(def ^:private pr-writer-impl
  (fn [obj writer opts]
  (cond
    (nil? obj) (-write writer "nil")
    :else
    (do
      (let [m (when (print-meta? opts obj) (meta obj))
            ;; A keyword :type is print-method's dispatch value, which
            ;; Clojure's default method removes before printing.
            m (if (keyword? (get m :type)) (dissoc m :type) m)]
        (when (pos? (count m))
          (-write writer "^")
          (if (and (== 1 (count m)) (get m :tag))
            (pr-writer (get m :tag) writer opts)
            (pr-writer m writer opts))
          (-write writer " ")))
      (cond
        ;; FIXME: can we figure out something better here?
        ;; handle CLJS ctors
        (suss.bootstrap/type-constructor? obj)
        (pr-constructor-writer obj writer opts)

        ; Use the new, more efficient, IPrintWithWriter interface when possible.
        (satisfies? IPrintWithWriter obj)
        (-pr-writer obj writer opts)

        (or (true? obj) (false? obj))
        (-write writer (str_ obj))

        (number? obj)
        (-write writer
          (cond
            (not (== obj obj)) "##NaN"
            (identical? obj ##Inf) "##Inf"
            (identical? obj ##-Inf) "##-Inf"
            :else (str_ obj)))

        (object? obj)
        (do
          (-write writer "#js ")
          (print-map
            (pr-object-map
              (js-keys obj)
              (fn [k]
                (MapEntry.
                  (if (pr-object-keyword? k) (keyword k) k)
                  (unchecked-get obj k)
                  nil)))
            pr-writer writer opts))

        (array? obj)
        (pr-sequential-writer writer pr-writer "#js [" " " "]" opts obj)

        (string? obj)
        (if (or (pr-opts-dup opts) (pr-opts-readably opts))
          (-write writer (quote-string obj))
          (-write writer obj))

        (js-fn? obj)
        (let [name (pr-function-name obj)
              name (if (or (nil? name) (= "" name))
                     "Function"
                     name)]
          (write-all writer "#object[" name
            (if *print-fn-bodies*
              (str_ " \"" (str_ obj) "\"")
              "")
            "]"))

        ;; Clojure's print-method for Throwable, IDeref and Object (#304).
        (instance? ExceptionInfo obj)
        (pr-throwable obj writer opts)

        (satisfies? IDeref obj)
        (pr-tagged-object obj (deref-as-map obj) writer opts)

        :else
        (pr-tagged-object obj (str obj) writer opts))))))
rationale: Retain the pinned default printer's branch order, metadata prefix, protocol precedence, numeric exceptional spelling, readable strings, function printing and object/array branches. Expand defn to def/fn. Replace primitive NaN/infinity/empty-string operations with their portable equivalents and constructor storage inspection with the owned descriptor guard. Expand the single cond-> application to an if over the already-bound key, preserving one predicate evaluation and keyword conversion only on the selected branch. The #js object helpers (pr-object-map, pr-object-keyword?) remain declared but undefined, so that path fails visibly. Metadata follows Clojure's print-meta (#302): empty metadata and a keyword :type are not printed, a lone :tag prints as ^tag, and strings print readably under *print-dup*. Values that are not data follow Clojure's default print-method (#304), replacing the host Date, RegExp, JS symbol and constructor-name branches, which name host values Suss does not have: a type value prints its name (print-method Class), an ExceptionInfo prints as print-throwable without stack frames, an IDeref prints as print-tagged-object of deref-as-map, and any other object as print-tagged-object of its str. The helpers are original Suss in core's appendix.
